556:t_1:86.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Those are the $$ウィスパード$$.」

556:t_1:87.en:
$$隼人$$
「...There's one thing I don't understand. Who is sending that Black Technology?」

556:t_1:88.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The one sending information to the $$ウィスパード$$... The $$ウィスパリング$$, in other words, is...」

556:t_1:89.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$カナメ$$ from the future.」

556:t_1:91.en:
$$テッサ$$
「More precisely, it is probably the personality of $$ソフィア$$, a girl who died in the experiment 18 years ago and now possesses $$カナメ$$.」

556:t_1:92.en:
$$タケル$$
「So the will of someone whose body died 18 years ago is controlling her now...」

556:t_1:93.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We believe the will sent by the $$ウィスパリング$$ caused the world to follow an entirely different path from its intended history.」

556:t_1:94.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The culmination of that is the existence of ASes.」

556:t_1:96.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Indeed... The way those weapons appeared was certainly unusual.」

556:t_1:97.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The technology used in ASes does not fit existing systems. You could call it a mutation.」

556:t_1:98.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「So they're products of Black Technology.」

556:t_1:99.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Those technologies produced further developments, and we can say they affected the very nature of the world.」

556:t_1:100.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ called this a distorted world.」

556:t_1:101.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Together with supporters such as $$カリーニン$$, $$レナード$$ intends to cause a new $$時空震動$$ to correct this world.」

556:t_1:102.en:
$$桂$$
「Put simply, it's a selfish attempt to repair space-time.」

556:t_1:103.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「To think Major $$カリーニン$$ defected to $$アマルガム$$...」

556:t_1:104.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Everyone has their reasons. Forget about him.」

556:t_1:105.en:
$$テッサ$$
「For that purpose, $$レナード$$ developed a $$時空震動弾$$ and built 《$$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$》, a system to control it.」

556:t_1:106.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We discovered it was being built on $$メリダ島$$ and attempted to destroy it, but...」

556:t_1:107.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$レナード$$ teleported it to the ruins of $$第３新東京市$$.」

556:t_1:108.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We still haven't confirmed the situation underground there. So he moved the system there...」

556:t_1:109.en:
$$マリ$$
「But I'm thinking... If they're going to repair space-time, couldn't we just leave them alone?」

556:t_1:110.en:
$$マリ$$
「It'll just create another parallel world. It shouldn't affect this world.」

556:t_1:111.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I do not intend to reject that way of thinking.」

556:t_1:112.en:
$$テッサ$$
「However, $$レナード$$ has taken many lives to carry out his plan.」

556:t_1:113.en:
$$宗介$$
「At the very least, he robbed $$千鳥$$ of her freedom and distorted her fate.」

556:t_1:114.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Those acts are unforgivable. And a $$時空震動$$ large enough to remake the world would have unpredictable effects on space-time.」

556:t_1:115.en:
$$アスカ$$
「If it goes wrong, the world could end. Like with $$サードインパクト$$.」

556:t_1:117.en:
$$テッサ$$
「So, for the sake of those sacrificed for his plan as well, I intend to stop his ambition.」

556:t_1:118.en:
$$テッサ$$
「If you wish to call that personal, feel free. But I will not change my mind.」

556:t_1:119.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「You don't have to bear all that responsibility and sense of duty alone, $$テッサ$$.」

556:t_1:120.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We have no intention of standing by while the world faces destruction, either.」

556:t_1:121.en:
$$ランド$$
「We owe that bastard for what he did to us in $$第２新東京市$$, too.」

556:t_1:122.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We cannot accept repairing space-time for selfish reasons.」

556:t_1:124.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You're all right with that too, $$マリ$$?」

556:t_1:125.en:
$$マリ$$
「I wasn't opposing it in the first place.」

556:t_1:126.en:
$$マリ$$
「Besides, I don't personally like people who think they alone can do whatever they want.」

556:t_1:127.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Every second appears to count. We will head for the ruins of $$第３新東京市$$ in one hour, once sortie preparations are complete.」

556:t_1:128.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Board your machines and stand by. Remember that this battle will determine the world's fate.」

556:t_1:130.en:
$$万丈$$
「...Before that future of despair, the world's destruction is already waiting right on our doorstep.」

556:t_1:131.en:
$$桂$$
「But if that future of despair and the universe's great collapse every 120 million years are space-time disasters, this operation matters a great deal.」

556:t_1:132.en:
$$勝平$$
「What do you mean, Big Bro $$桂$$?」

556:t_1:133.en:
$$桂$$
「When I contacted the collective unconscious on $$神根島$$, I learned that $$オルソン$$ and I are powerless against the space-time disasters ahead.」

556:t_1:134.en:
$$オルソン$$
「We are singularities of the $$大時空震動$$, but apparently our power alone cannot restore space-time to its original, most stable state now.」

556:t_1:135.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「'Our power alone' is the key phrase, then.」

556:t_1:136.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Exactly. When I was imprisoned in a $$サイデリアル$$ research facility, a researcher there said this about singularities.」

556:t_1:138.en:
$$万丈$$
「So besides you and $$桂$$, there is another singularity who is a key to repairing space-time.」

556:t_1:139.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Someone who was there when the current chaos in space-time began... The original singularity...」

556:t_1:140.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Do you know about this, $$グーラ$$?」

556:t_1:141.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Gathering the singularities' wills at the place or space where the $$時空震動$$ began, the great singularity, completes the space-time repair...」

556:t_1:142.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I only have the knowledge myself.」

556:t_1:143.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Then if $$桂$$ and the others go to that great singularity, will this whole multiverse go back to normal?」

556:t_1:144.en:
$$グーラ$$
「In theory. But I have no idea where the knot joining all these intricately tangled parallel worlds is.」

556:t_1:145.en:
$$オルソン$$
「We will likely need to gather the three singularities to face the coming crises on a universal scale as well.」

556:t_1:146.en:
$$桂$$
「And that's why I figure $$かなめ$$ is the third one.」

556:t_1:147.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see... If she has the power to distort the world, that is quite possible.」

556:t_1:148.en:
$$桂$$
「Exactly. For the sake of the future, too, we cannot afford to lose this battle.」

556:t_1:149.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「To think $$かなめ$$ had that kind of power...」

556:t_1:150.en:
$$ノノ$$
「A hidden mystical power...! $$ノノ$$ has something in common with her!」

556:t_1:151.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Honestly... She doesn't seem to understand how serious this is, does she, $$ニコラ$$?」

556:t_1:154.en:
$$チコ$$
「What's wrong? Is something worrying you?」

556:t_1:156.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「If we could do that, we wouldn't have any trouble.」

556:t_1:158.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I wish you wouldn't say things like that so lightly.」

556:t_1:160.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Only people who have truly known despair have the right to talk about changing the world.」

556:t_1:163.en:
$$タケル$$
「Calm down. What did $$シンジ$$ do to you?」

556:t_1:164.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$$タケル$$... You don't understand how I feel.」
